name: Ohio State Fall 2023

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

venue.name: [Recreation and Physical Activity Center (RPAC)](https://recsports.osu.edu/)
venue.address: 337 Annie and John Glenn Ave. Columbus, OH 43210

information:
This competition features a 30 minute cumulative time limit for 5x5, 6x6, and 7x7 all together. This means that you have a combined total of 30 minutes to complete your 5x5, 6x6, and 7x7 solves (you can sign up for any combination of the 3). You can choose to do the events in any order, but you must finish an event's average (or DNS the rest) before moving on to the next event. Please review regulation [#A1a2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A1a2) if you wish to compete in either 5x5, 6x6, or 7x7. There will also be a 25 minute cumulative time limit for 3x3 Blindfolded.

The competition will take place in Meeting Rooms #1-3 in the RPAC.
